The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking an experienced Director Product Manager to join Adobe Commerce product management team in San Jose. Strong leadership skills will be required to drive consensus on requirements, deliver high quality outcomes, and maintain a fast pace of execution.

·       Lead a team of product managers to define and champion product vision and strategy for Agentic conversion on e-commerce channels including storefront, LLM interfaces, marketplaces, social channels and more.

·       Work collaboratively with the rest of the Digital Experience and Digital Media product teams to ensure we bring innovation from the rest of Adobe, to Adobe Commerce.

·       Research customer and market needs, conduct competitive analysis

Senior Growth Product Manager – Adobe Experience Cloud

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Cloud enables enterprises to deliver personalized, data-driven digital experiences at scale. We are seeking a Senior Growth Product Manager to drive Product-Led Growth (PLG) across Experience Cloud products by accelerating user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.

This role is ideal for a growth leader with deep experience in B2B SaaS and Digital Marketing Technology, who thrives at the intersection of product, experimentation and data. You will drive and implement growth strategies across key user journeys, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams to turn customer insight into scalable growth engines.

What You’ll Do

Growth Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Drive and evolve end-to-end growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion for an Experience Cloud product.
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using data, research and experimentation.
  • Develop and prioritize a growth roadmap tied to clear business impact.

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Design, launch, and analyze a high-velocity experimentation program across critical user journeys.
  • Drive rapid test-and-learn cycles that ensure rigorous experiment design by establishing clear hypotheses, calculating statistical power, and implementing appropriate guardrails.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to build robust instrumentation for accurate measurement and monitoring. Oversee careful rollout strategies—including phased launches, A/B testing, and control groups—to minimize risk and improve actionable insights.

Technology-Based Growth Initiatives

  • Identify, prioritize, and ship product experiences powered by advanced technology that improve conversion and retention—e.g., personalization, predictive mentorship, and intelligent onboarding.
  • Use AI to speed up experiment ideation, hypothesis generation, copy/variant drafting, and analysis—while maintaining statistical rigor and human review.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to co-develop and implement growth initiatives, navigating trade-offs and driving alignment across teams
  • Proven ability to influence product roadmaps and drive outcomes in a matrixed environment without direct authority
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning multiple teams around shared goals

Work in close coordination with:

  • Product Leaders who own core product to co-develop and implement a growth roadmap
  • Engineering to implement experimentation infrastructure
  • Design & UX Research to optimize onboarding and feature discovery
  • Marketing to align product growth levers with acquisition strategies
  • Finance & Data Science to quantify business impact

What You Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of Growth Product Management experience, with significant focus on experimentation-driven optimization.
  • Proven experience driving B2B Product-Led Growth in SaaS or Digital Marketing Technology platforms.
  • Experience implementing and executing experimentation tools.
  • Deep expertise in experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, funnel optimization, and cohort analysis.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise customer journeys, including self-serve, sales-assisted, and hybrid motions.
  • Fluency in applying AI to product discovery, experimentation, and growth workflows, with a commitment to continuous skill development.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools for accelerating prototyping and insight generation.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data and customer insight into shipped product experiences with measurable impact.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize insights into clear narratives that drive action.

Most Importantly

You value outcomes over activity, learning over certainty, and are deeply customer obsessed. You believe Product-Led Growth is an operating model, not a feature, and you thrive in environments where experimentation, insight, and collaboration drive impact.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to have you help shape the future of Experience Cloud.

Role Summary
Adobe is building Firefly Foundry Studio—a managed enterprise platform that unifies Adobe’s professional creative tools and customized Firefly Foundry models to deliver advanced Generative AI workflows for Media & Entertainment production.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will work at the intersection of frontier generative models, VFX/animation pipelines, and enterprise software to define and ship the capabilities that let studios, post houses, and streaming platforms harness GenAI at production scale.

This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role!

What You’ll Do
Product Strategy & Vision
  • Own the end-to-end product roadmap aligning Firefly Foundry model capabilities and Studio creative interfaces into a coherent product strategy.
  • Define and prioritize capabilities, balancing near-term Enterprise needs with long-term platform vision
     
Execution & Delivery
  • Drive quarterly planning and execution with Engineering, Applied Science, and Product Design; manage trade-offs between model capability, creative control, and enterprise governance.
  • Define success metrics and evals (adoption, generation quality, workflow efficiency, customer expansion).
     
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner with Adobe’s Creative Technologist field team to compose and deploy tailored workflows for enterprise M&E customers.
  • Represent the Foundry Studio team at executive reviews, industry events, and partner forums!
     
What You’ll Bring
Required
  • 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years shipping software products serving creative professionals or media production workflows.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Generative AI products or platforms—ranging from model fine-tuning, inference pipelines, or GenAI-powered creative tools.
  • Deep domain knowledge of VFX, animation, or post-production pipelines including compositing, look development, pre-visualization, and editorial workflows.
  • Strong technical competence across GenAI concepts: diffusion models, LoRA/fine-tuning, conditioning controls, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and cost/quality trade-offs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to craft compelling product narratives, PRDs, and executive-level strategy documents.
  • Track record of leading complex, multi-team initiatives in a matrixed organization without direct authority.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with studio pipeline platforms (ShotGrid/Flow, AYON, ftrack).
  • Familiarity with content authenticity standards (C2PA/CAI) and studio security/compliance requirements (TPN, MPAA).
  • MBA or advanced technical degree.

raw_workday_record.jobDescription:
The Opportunity

Adobe's data platform is a vertical data intelligence stack: raw signals are governed and routed at ingestion, enriched and catalogued into curated enterprise definitions, and ultimately transformed into retrieval-ready, agent-optimized knowledge assets. The knowledge tier sits at the top of that stack. Curated definitions become trustworthy, retrieval-ready knowledge. AI agents, self-service analytics, and enterprise decision systems consume this knowledge every day.

As Senior Product Manager for this layer, you own its execution throughout the entire process. This includes how knowledge assets are modeled, published, maintained, and delivered to consuming agents via retrieval and integration interfaces. You'll turn a multi-quarter roadmap into shipped capabilities, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and peer platform PMs. This is a builder's role at the sharp end of Adobe's agent-ready data strategy.


What you'll own

  • Own the product roadmap — develop and drive a 6–12 month roadmap for knowledge-asset modeling, retrieval APIs, agent-integration interfaces, and embedding/RAG pipelines, prioritizing and re-prioritizing against shifting platform needs.
  • Lead delivery from inception to launch — provide project leadership and day-to-day management spanning engineering and build, making thoughtful quality / customer-value / time-to-market tradeoffs and mitigating risk.
  • Own knowledge freshness and lifecycle — define how curated definitions are ingested, versioned, deprecated, and kept current, so consuming agents never retrieve stale or orphaned knowledge.
  • Deliver the trust signals for the knowledge layer—freshness, lineage, and quality—so knowledge assets can be safely consumed by agents, while contributing these signals to the platform-wide agent readiness score.
  • Build human-in-the-loop correction workflows at the knowledge layer — define what triggers human review of a knowledge asset, and how corrections propagate to downstream consumers.
  • Write clear engineering PRDs — translate platform requirements into prioritized features, crisp specifications, and concrete performance measures and safety thresholds.
  • Partner across the platform team — align with peer PMs owning metadata, event telemetry, and cross-cutting governance so retrieval and embedding surfaces are built on governed, trustworthy foundations.
  • Prototype to think — use vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to stand up quick, testable prototypes that reduce risk in build choices ahead of engineering dedication.


What you require to succeed

  • Track record: 7+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years owning a data platform, data infrastructure, or enterprise data product end to end — not just contributing to one.
  • AI knowledge-stack fluency: Working knowledge of knowledge-graph concepts, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures, MCP servers, and agent skills, plus a working understanding of how agents and models consume data and what makes an asset "agent-ready."
  • Quality workflows: Experience with human-in-the-loop quality and correction workflows in production data systems.
  • Specification skill: Ability to write engineering PRDs that translate complex technical systems into clear user problems, prioritized features, and measurable success metrics and guardrails.
  • Rapid prototyping: Ability to design and build quick prototypes through vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to de-risk decisions before engineering invests.
  • Systems thinking and business judgment: able to reason about the platform as a causal chain rather than independent features, and to articulate how a decision drives adoption, retention, and downstream platform value.
  • Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to drive cross-functional delivery across engineering and program through influence rather than authority, with comfort operating at ambiguous (roadmap) and precise (specification) altitudes simultaneously.

The Opportunity

Adobe's creative community connects millions of makers every month, from first-timers to industry icons. We're building the Creative Agents that will define how those creators work in an AI-native world. Behind every good agent is a lot of high-leverage execution: the tools it can call, the skills it knows, and whether each one actually works when a creator needs it. Right now a lot of our focus sits at the harness and model level — we still need to dig deeper into the tools and skills layer, and it needs a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on role. You'll live in the details of how our tools and skills behave, drive fit-and-finish across the experience, ship improvements constantly, and build the measurement that lets a fast-moving team know it's getting better. You'll sit embedded in a cross-functional team of PMs, designers, and engineers, partner closely with our AI Platform (AIP) team, and use AI by default in everything you do.

What you'll do

  • Own the tools and skills lifecycle end to end — triage what the agent needs, spec it, coordinate the build with engineering, test it, and iterate based on how it performs in the wild. This is the core of the role.

  • Work with AIP — partner with the AI Platform team on tools and skills integration and dependencies, and make sure our needs are represented in their roadmap.
  • Structure and refine prompts and system instructions, running tight experiment loops to improve how tools and skills behave.
  • Close the loop with clear, regular reporting on tool and skill quality and reliability so the whole team knows where things stand.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. A background in Computer Science or Engineering is preferred.
  • 5+ years in product management or an equivalent area, shipping consumer or creator products.
  • Enough technical depth to work closely with engineers, reason about how tools and skills are built, and dig into root causes yourself.
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI tools, and genuine curiosity about how agents and LLMs behave.
  • A track record of driving UX quality and fit-and-finish across a product, working closely with design, and prioritizing well when there's more to do than time to do it.
  • Strong data and experimentation instincts: you can define a metric, read a dashboard, and tell signal from noise.
  • Clear communication and a track record of leading and prioritizing across functions.

The Opportunity

Privacy is changing quickly. People are more aware of their privacy rights and want more control over their data, especially as AI has become part of our everyday work. Regulations are also evolving rapidly across many regions. These changes matter to Adobe as the company expands across consumer, professional, and enterprise markets worldwide. We are looking for a collaborative and innovative Lead Product Manager to guide the strategy and execution of our vision for experiential privacy. In this role, you will help manage privacy risks, identify new opportunities, and build transparent, user-centered solutions that support Adobe’s values and business goals.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will need to think strategically, influence others, and work closely with teams across Adobe, including Creativity & Productivity, Customer Experience Orchestration, Adobe Unified Platform Engineering, Digital Employee Experience, and Legal. To succeed, you are comfortable with change, act with urgency, take ownership, and deliver results while partnering with multiple teams and managing competing priorities.

What You'll Do

  • Understand needs around data protection and privacy compliance in our products, services and platforms.
  • Translate customer, business, and legal needs into clear requirements and engage with engineering teams to deliver outstanding solutions users trust with their data.
  • Help build features, capabilities, and tools composed to keep user and company data protected while offering transparency around how our company processes data.
  • Collaborate with experience design teams driving the creation of mockups and review user interface designs to help ensure all privacy controls are implemented in accordance with privacy policies and requirements.
  • Build, document and communicate key use cases as the basis for comprehensive, end-to-end features and user acceptance testing for privacy requirements and solutions.
  • Build privacy success metrics/criteria and supervise performance
  • Partner with legal to assist in the review of privacy impact assessments for different platforms, products, tools, and services.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations for higher-level management including Directors, VPs and Senior Leaders with progress, risks and opportunities for privacy-focused capabilities and processes.
  • Act as an advocate and evangelist for privacy and data protection, leading internal training and building awareness.

What is Needed to Succeed
